messages:
marta_support: FYI, getting a customer escalation — multiple hosted requests returning 503s for /v1/complete. Customer cust-5012 and another internal smoke test. Seeing upstream worker exits in the logs.
ajay_oncall: on it. can you paste the gateway logs and any runner logs you have?
marta_support: gateway shows upstream 502/503 aggregated by the API gateway. runner log snippet attached below. happened ~09:12 UTC after a traffic spike.
marta_support: ```
[2026-03-15T09:11:58Z] runner[pid=8421] ERROR: Alloc failed: CUDA out of memory
[2026-03-15T09:11:59Z] runner[pid=8421] INFO: Attempting cleanup and restart
[2026-03-15T09:12:00Z] kernel: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f9bf... sp 0x7fff... error 4 in libattention.so
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] containerd: Container 7f3b4 exited with code 139
```
ajay_oncall: thanks. container exit 139 (segfault) after OOM — looks like a kernel-level crash in attention kernel. do we have the model + batchshape?
sara_prod: model rdx-turbo-v1, q4_0, batch_size=32 on that host for SLO lane. we rolled a new bin yesterday for attention kernel micro-optimizations.
lee_infra: :( that matches: last rollout changed prefetch config and default batch cap. traffic spike + bigger batch -> KV cache grew and pushed GPU mem over the limit.
ajay_oncall: deploy-bot, can you show the recent deploy event for that runner?
deploy-bot: Deployment event: job=runner-service image=redwood/runner:2026.03.14-build.572, rolled to pool=hosted-gpu-a4-3, started at 2026-03-14T23:05:11Z. Canary 10% -> 100% by 2026-03-15T02:40:22Z.
sara_prod: rolling back the micro-opt change would be my immediate ask. hotfix: revert to runner:2026.03.13-build.558 and force batch_cap=16 for SLO lane.
marta_support: meanwhile customers still seeing 503s, can we add routing fallback to smaller model variant? customer needs immediate availability.
lee_infra: yes we can route SLO lane to rdx-turbo-v1-small or to CPU fallback for low QPS customers. setting temporary routing policy now.
ajay_oncall: mitigation steps I'm executing: 1) drain and cordon affected hosts 2) scale up spare runners in dedicated pool 3) apply hot routing to smaller variant. will follow up with logs.
marta_support: noted, telling customer cust-5012 support is aware and mitigation in progress.
sara_prod: follow-up action: revert attention micro-opt kernel + add preflight doh check in rollout pipeline to simulate KV growth workloads. also create a perf test with long prompts+streaming to catch OOMs.
lee_infra: creating infra ticket to add GPU memory headroom alert and tighten autoscaler trigger on memory pressure.
ajay_oncall: recorded for postmortem. immediate ETA for full recovery ~15-25m unless another host crashes. will post final once stable. :white_check_mark:
marta_support: thanks team. assigning owners: ajay on oncall mitigation, sara to author rollback PR, lee infra to routing/scale changes, marta to handle customer comms.
